exercises.title: The world in 2050
exercises.text: What will life be like in 2050? Scientists predict that, by then, the global population will have reached nearly ten billion. Many of us will be living in megacities, and most cars on the road will be electric. If current trends continue, the Arctic will have lost most of its summer ice. But there is hope: renewable energy is getting cheaper every year, and by 2050 many countries will have stopped burning coal completely.

questions.text: The population will have reached nearly ___ billion.

exercises.title: Heatwave warning

script.speaker: Forecaster
script.text: A heatwave is on its way. By Thursday, temperatures will have reached thirty-eight degrees in the south. This weekend many people will be heading to the coast, so expect heavy traffic. There's no rain in the forecast, and by next week the drought will have lasted over a month.

questions.statement: Rain is expected at the weekend.

theory.title: Zero и First Conditional, придаточные времени

head: Тип
Схема
Пример
rows: If you heat ice, it melts.
If you leave now, you'll catch the train.

theory.text: После when, as soon as, until, before, after, unless, in case, provided that — Present (не will), даже о будущем.

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I land.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
You can borrow it provided that you return it.
examples.ru: Можешь взять при условии, что вернёшь.

theory.tip: unless = if not: Unless you hurry = If you don't hurry. in case ≠ if: in case — «на всякий случай».

exercises.title: How to pass any exam
exercises.text: If you want to remember something, test yourself — don't just reread it. Research shows that students who practise recalling information remember twice as much. Study in short sessions: unless you take breaks, your concentration drops after about 40 minutes. Sleep is essential too: as soon as you sleep, your brain starts organising what you've learned. And before the exam, eat something light in case nerves make you feel sick.

questions.statement: Sleep helps the brain organise new information.

exercises.title: A green city
exercises.text: Copenhagen aims to be carbon-neutral. By then, the city will have replaced coal with wind and biomass, and most people will be cycling to work — already more than 60% do. Unless other cities take similar steps, experts say, global targets will be impossible to reach.
